text:
Ellie Nakamura: Hi all 44b! First day on infra-platform. Laptop arrived and I'm mostly set up but my USB-C dock isn't enumerating external monitor or ethernet. Mac shows 'No devices found' under System Report. Anyone run into this? Also what's lunch like? I can bring sushi tomorrow.

Jonas Becker: welcome Ellie! ping @IT Support for hardware. Quick Q: which dock model? Some older docks need the DisplayLink driver on mac.

Ellie Nakamura: It's a Dell D6000 USB-C dock.

IT Support: Hi Ellie 4bb Dell D6000 uses DisplayLink. Can you try installing the driver: `brew install --cask displaylink-driver` then reboot. If you prefer, we can swap the dock for a TB4 model. Also send your device serial so we can check warranty.

Ellie Nakamura: running the install now. Also serial is C02X1234MD6R.

DockBot: Hardware ticket created: #HW-2245 for Ellie Nakamura. Status: driver_install_pending.

Jonas Becker: fyi sometimes SIP blocks kernel extensions on mac. If install fails, open System Settings 7 Security & Privacy 7 and allow the DisplayLink extension, then reboot.

Ellie Nakamura: installer asked to allow kernel extension, I approved in Security & Privacy and rebooted 44d. Monitor now shows up and ethernet works 6a74bb. Thanks!

IT Support: Verified driver installed and network up. We'll keep ticket open 24h to watch for disconnects. If you want a TB4 dock shipped, reply here and we'll arrange.

Ellie Nakamura: all good for now, thanks! Also quick access question: where's the internal infra-runbooks? I couldn't find the alert routing doc.

Maya Lin: runbooks are at https://confluence.redwood.team/infra/runbooks. Alert routing is in the incident response page under 'paging -> oncall routing'. I'll add you to the infra-runbooks group now.

IT Support: Added Ellie to infra-runbooks and infra-oncall groups. Expect repo invites in ~10 minutes.

DockBot: Updated #HW-2245: driver_installed: true, monitor_connected: true, ethernet_connected: true. Closing in 24h unless reopened.

Ellie Nakamura: sweet. Also curious about team lunches and socials 60b. Sushi offer still stands if you want.

Jonas Becker: Sushi tomorrow sounds ace. We usually do a rotating order Fri lunch and random mini socials on Weds. Also we have a 10-min Friday "show-and-share" 7 bring a tiny hobby/demo.

Ellie Nakamura: Fun fact: I fold miniature origami animals and make tiny habitats for them. Can bring a few for show-and-share 4c0338.

HR Bot: Welcome to Redwood Inference, Ellie! Please complete the new hire forms: https://redwood.inference/hr/newhire. Orientation at 9:30 in #all-hands.

Jonas Becker: I'll DM you the Slack huddle link for a 2pm buddy intro. Welcome aboard! :tada:

Ellie Nakamura: Thanks everyone 970. Appreciate the quick help and warm welcome.
